candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E no get cough or any wahala to breathe. E never get diarrhoea. E get ear problem. E no get fever. E no dey convulse now. E never get convulsion before. E no dey weak or dey unconscious. E dey fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Dem no report say e ear dey discharge before. E ear no dey pain am. I see pus dey come out for e ear. E no get any swelling wey dey pain behind e ear.
